column3: “Execute” supplies the relation to wrath; “triumph” specifies His exaltation.
The repeated “Listen” supplies commands to introduce the sounds.
“Flushed with fear” interprets the image of faces of flames.
“Scarcer” and “rarer” give a scarcity sense to making man precious.
“Without a shepherd” specifies the absence of one gathering the flock.
“Fortresses” stands for palaces; “Babylon” supplies the referent of “her.”
